The user approved the A1+ Unit 2 plan on 2026-11-19 (A1+ 2.Y follows A1 2.Y, one grammar step each) and chose "Straight to Preview": no per-lesson gates, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, reviewed in Preview. Batch B (2.6-2.10) was started on the user's "Start Batch B". Each photo is the elevator lobby of one floor, with a large floor number on the wall beside the elevator and the place behind a glass wall: a gym (2), a clothing store (3), a restaurant (4) and an indoor pool (5). Nobody is in the photos, so the teacher and the co-teacher read every line. Picture cards choose the floor by its number (It is the fourth floor.); sentence cards keep the place and change only the floor; Where is the …? replies change only the floor. An earlier plan with five cars at a traffic light was dropped because the image tool drew four cars, not five.

lesson.title: 2.6 On the second floor
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Say which floor a place is on with second, third, fourth and fifth (The gym is on the second floor. / Where is the pool? It is on the fifth floor.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.6 Numbers 1-5: A1 counts one to five; A1+ 2.6 puts things in order with the ordinal numbers second, third, fourth and fifth, after the + before a noun (the second floor). A1 already says First, … for the first step of a routine. Each photo shows the elevator lobby of one floor of a building, with the floor number on the wall and the place behind a glass wall: the gym on 2, a store on 3, a restaurant on 4 and a pool on 5.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.6 one to five; A1 4.6 First, …; A1 4.15 the floor; A1 2.1 store, restaurant; A1+ 2.1 gym, pool; A1 Where is …?
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say second with a clear d, third with th and a long er, fourth with th at the end, fifth with f-th at the end. Do not require native-like speed.
